name: Sneak Cheese
summary:
Get ready to think fast, plan carefully, and try not to become dinner in Sneak Cheese, a cozy and strategic puzzle game where a tiny mouse must push every piece of cheese into the burrows while trying to survive cats that are always ready to pounce!

Every move matters. Push the cheese through the environment, find the right path to the burrows, and turn every space on the board into part of your strategy. But don't think it will be that simple. With every valid move you make, the cats react too, and knowing exactly when they will move can mean the difference between a perfect escape and a disastrous capture!

You will encounter different types of cats, each with its own behavior. Some remain stationary but attack anything that appears directly in front of them. Others patrol the environment after every move you make, while the slower ones wait for the right moment to advance. Watch their routes, track their cycles, and plan every step before putting yourself in danger!

Across 30 handcrafted levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new challenges and increasingly clever combinations will put your reasoning to the test. You will need to figure out the right order for pushing the cheese, avoid getting trapped, predict the cats' movements, and make sure the little mouse stays alive until the final piece of cheese reaches its destination.
